src.title: How to make the BEST Air Fryer Donuts

recipes.title: Glazed Air Fryer Donuts

items.i: all-purpose flour, plus more as needed

steps: Mix the warm water, warm milk, yeast and 1 tbsp sugar. Let it froth for 5–10 minutes (if it doesn't, start over with fresh yeast).

In a stand mixer add the 1/3 cup sugar, melted butter, egg, yolk, vanilla, flour (spooned and leveled) and salt, then the yeast mixture. Mix with the dough hook on low until combined, then on high for 5 minutes. Add flour 1 tbsp at a time only if very sticky; it should stay slightly tacky.
Place in a greased bowl, cover and let rise in a warm place about 1 hour, until doubled.
Punch down, roll out 1/2 inch thick on a floured surface and cut with a donut cutter (or 4-inch and 1¼-inch biscuit cutters). Re-roll scraps; you'll get about 9–12 donuts plus holes.
Set on a parchment-lined tray, cover lightly and let rise 20–30 minutes.
Preheat the air fryer to 345°F (175°C). Spray the basket, add about 4 donuts (not touching), spray the tops and air fry 5–6 minutes. Repeat; holes need about a minute less.
Whisk the powdered sugar, milk, corn syrup and vanilla until smooth. Dip the donuts while still warm for a shiny glaze, set on a rack over a tray, and toss the holes in the remaining glaze.
recipes.notes: Recipe is the creator's; macros are estimated per glazed donut (based on 10).
